name: GL_ESSBASE_BALANCES_DELTA
description: This table contains sets of incremental balances that need to be applied to an Oracle Essbase cube.

columns.name: DELTA_RUN_ID
columns.description: Set of incremental balance data that this row belongs to.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger of the incremental balance data.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Account of the incremental balance data.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the incremental balance data.

columns.name: TRANSLATED_FLAG
columns.description: Currency type of the incremental balance data. Valid values are X (functional currency balance), R (foreign currency balance), Y (up-to-date translated balance), and N (out-of-date translated balance).

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period of the incremental balance data.

columns.name: ACTUAL_FLAG
columns.description: Balance type of the incremental balance data. Valid values are A (actual) and E (encumbrance).

columns.name: ENCUMBRANCE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Encumbrance type of the incremental balance data. A value of -99 is used if the balance is an actual balance.

columns.name: FIX_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of incremental fix to the Oracle Essbase balance. Valid values are ADD and REMOVE.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
